properties.name: LBCBLR070
properties.notes: Demolition of hostel and erection of 3 - 6 storey building plus roof plant enclosure and excavation of 2 storey basement to provide 33 self-contained wheelchair accessible flats for the care & well-being of older people (13 x 2-bed & 20 x 3-bed) including ancillary extra-care and treatment rooms, restaurant, health & well-being facility, gym, communal lounges, guest suite, cycle and mobility scooter storage and staff facilities with basement level car park , communal garden and associated landscaping.
properties.site-address: Arthur West House 79 Fitzjohn's Avenue London NW3 6PA
